name: ponytail-debt
title_zh: 代码里那些 ponytail 注释
tagline_zh: AI 写代码时留下的「先这样，回头再说」，散在几十个文件里没人再翻。它一次扫全仓，按文件和类型列成账本。
tagline_en: Ponytail's "later, I promise" comments rot across dozens of files. One scan turns them into a readable ledger, so.
desc_en: Harvest every `ponytail:` comment in the codebase into a debt ledger, so the deliberate shortcuts and deferrals ponytail leaves behind get tracked instead of rotting into "later means never". Use when the user says "ponytail debt", "/ponytail-debt", "what did ponytail defer", "list the shortcuts", "ponytail ledger", or "what did we mark to do later". One-shot report, changes nothing.
why_zh: 只认 `ponytail:` 这个前缀，不猜、不推断、不改代码。纯读一遍，输出即账本。
why_en: Matches only the `ponytail:` prefix — no guessing, no inference, no edits. Read-only pass, output is the ledger, repo unchanged.
limit_zh: 只认字面 `ponytail:` 前缀的注释，别的 TODO/FIXME 一律不收；只出报告不建 issue。
limit_en: Only literal `ponytail:` comments — other TODO/FIXME markers are ignored. Report only: no issues filed, no code changes, no prioritization. Vague.
title_en: Every ponytail: comment in your codebase, gathered into.
